setup:
@known_a fact
  holds parent(person_a_0, person_b_0)
  valid timeless
  source synthetic
@known_b fact
  holds parent(person_b_0, person_c_0)
  valid timeless
  source synthetic
@grandparent_rule rule
  when parent(?x, ?y)
  when parent(?y, ?z)
  then grandparent(?x, ?z)
  mode logical
target:
@c constraint
  var ?arrival int 0 1440
  require ?arrival == 770 + 30
  claim ?arrival <= 900
  task prove

@result solve
  constraint $c
  output ?arrival one

@answer cnl
  result $result
  language ro

packet.assurance: Relative to the declared domains and admitted constraints.

generated.source:
@result__reason reason
  constraint $c

@arrival binding
  result $result__reason
  variable ?arrival
  mode one
  owner result
